title: ScrollContainer freezes the app on some size settings
body:
### Tested versions

Godot v4.3.stable [both the gui and the console versions]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.19045 - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated Intel(R) HD Graphics 520 (Intel Corporation; 30.0.101.1338) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6300U CPU @ 2.40GHz (4 Threads)

### Issue description

When I use the project bellow with the steps defined, the game freezes. After a couple of seconds, the game is unfreezed but the visuals are all messed up (for example, I click the item, it gets deleted but the visual representation of it may or may not disappear). It's also worth mentioning that:

- If you reset the window size to default, it won't reproduce.
- If you reset the `Expand Mode` and `Stretch Mode` of the item to default, it won't reproduce.
- If you manually change the size of the ScrollContainer to be bigger (so the item is at its fullest width size), it won't reproduce.

I have no idea why these work but it seems like when you resize down the TextureRect, weird things happen (I was able to reproduce it with ColorRect as well). Also during the testing, at some point disabling the separation amount fixed the issue but as I was minimizing the project this went away.

I also have to mention that in the final steps of minimization, when I was trying to duplicate the cards, the editor froze and did some weird things but the project was unharmed. I'm saying this to imply "maybe it's my laptop"

### Steps to reproduce

Download and open the MRP, then start clicking on the items (remotely fast). After a couple of a clicks, it should freeze

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot-issue-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/19053334/github-issue.zip)
